thread:
Noah Kim: Heads-up — Walden Labs has their dedicated pool scheduled for cutover Friday 09:00 PDT. They committed 6xA100-equivalent and their SLOs: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 700ms. They expect baseline 220 rps, peak 900 rps. Renewal note: finance flagged unit-cost as a sticking point if we exceed projected spend.
Priya Desai: I'll coordinate warmup windows and own the smoke script. Plan: two-day priming: day-1 prefix prime + 4 short ramp windows, day-2 full soak at 75% peak for 45m. Also proposing a quick canary: 3% traffic for 20m before shift.
Elena Soto: Model lineup: primary redwood/opt-10-prod, secondary redwood/opt-8-q4. We'll enable KV caching for common prefixes; start with cache_size=32 tokens and observe. If p95 > 650ms, automatically route to secondary for new requests.
Carmen Li: Network checklist done except customer ACLs. Need Walden's firewall egress CIDRs and to confirm they will pre-provision NAT throughput (they previously underestimated). AE will push for temporary increase if needed.
Noah Kim: Priya, you own canary rollback policy and test failover. Carmen, please chase the ACLs. Elena, publish secondary model and drop model_hash here when ready.
Priya Desai: Draft k6 for the soak (will iterate):
```
k6 run --vus 400 --duration 45m --out json=walden_soak.json walden_probe.js
```
Probe will vary prompts across 20 unique templates, target median tokens ~120. Prefix prime snippet:
```
for i in $(seq 1 1000); do 
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate 
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
    -d '{"model":"redwood/opt-10-prod","prompt":"summary warmup"}' >/dev/null
done
```
Also will include a 10m gradual ramp test to validate autoscale decisions before the soak.
Elena Soto: Uploaded secondary model. model_hash: sha256:b72a6f4c3d9e... (pushed to catalog and verified). Ran a small bench: quantized path saved ~33% token cost with 7% quality drop measured by eval set.
Carmen Li: Walden network contact provided ACLs. Confirmed 3 NAT gateways with burst 20Gbps total. Ops team recommends we schedule warmup outside their peak API hours (10:00-16:00). They prefer 07:00-09:00 window.
Priya Desai: Updated plan: prefix prime Tue 07:30-08:00, staged ramps Tue 08:00 & Wed 07:30, pre-cutover canary Fri 08:30 (3% for 20m), then full shift 09:00. Failure injection: during canary we'll cordon a single GPU node and verify routing/fallback within 30s. Low blast radius.
Noah Kim: Autoscale knobs we agreed on: target GPU util 60%, scale up at 75%, scale down below 40% for 3m. Token backlog threshold 3000 for emergency scale. Also set a conservative ceiling of +2 GPUs above committed for the first 72h to avoid unexpected throttles.
Elena Soto: Also enabling metric-based fallback: if request p50 > 180ms for 5 consecutive minutes AND error rate > 0.5% route new sessions to secondary automatically. We'll log every fallback event for postmortem.
Carmen Li: Confirmed KMS latency baseline 9ms east region. We'll run a KMS sign/verify under 75% soak and capture 95th percentile. If > 50ms we notify Walden and enable local ephemeral keys for short tests.
Priya Desai: ETA for artifacts: load script + probe harness Tue EOD. I'll post runbook checklist (who pings customer, who runs scripts, who approves cutover).
Elena Soto: Cost delta estimate: secondary yields ~32% per-token cost savings in bench. With typical routing mix during fallback we estimate revenue impact < 6% but will give a formal delta after soak numbers.
Noah Kim: Renewal mitigation talking points (AE): 1) show measured p50/p95 vs commit targets, 2) demonstrate fallback cost controls and autoscale ceilings, 3) offer 30-day post-go-live discount if we exceed projected costs during first month. I'll draft and loop AE in.
OpsBot: Reminder set — walden_prefix_prime scheduled Tue 07:30 UTC. Use /ops report after runs. :white_check_mark:
Priya Desai: One last thing: we'll record the soak run and attach the k6 json + Grafana snapshots to the shared folder. Plan to debrief Wed 18:00 UTC.
Noah Kim: Great. Action items: Priya run prefix prime + staged ramps (ETA Tue morning), Elena publish model + monitor thresholds (done), Carmen confirm ACLs + KMS soak (done), Noah draft AE renewal notes (ETA Wed morning). Post results here and tag me. :thumbsup:
